title: Aristocratic Court — Source of Power in the Court

entries.value: Only legitimate heir to an important holding or title
Controls a large share of the court's rents and revenues
Widely loved and admired by the household members
Has access to a holy relic, enchanted weapon, or potent charm
Others fear the violence or brutality they might unleash
Has a special relationship with the overlord or king
Holds damaging secrets about important members
Everyone acknowledges their exceptional skill or wisdom
Runs an effective network of informants
Provides intimate services to the lord or an important person
Has an uncanny gift, faerie blood, or prophetic ability
Has the support of an important bishop or abbot
